title: ClaimInput
description: Request body accepted by POST /v1/evaluate and POST /v1/simulate on the Summit Cognitive Decision Receipt API. Mirrors the published reference at https://docs.summitcognitive.ai/api/reference; the served /v1/openapi.json is authoritative.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier for this claim. Use a stable, caller-generated id so the same decision can be found again later.

entity.description: The entity the claim is about — the thing being evaluated.

claim.description: Human-readable description of what is being asserted or proposed.

sources.description: Evidence supporting the claim. At least one source is required — a decision with no evidence is not evaluable.

items.description: A typed, provenanced evidence source: CI results, code review, test output, human approval, model traces.

expected_replay_match.description: Whether the caller expects this decision to reproduce deterministically on replay. Declaring the expectation lets the service flag divergence rather than silently accepting it.

action.description: Metadata about the action the decision authorizes — for example the repository, agent, or deployment target.

decision_rights.description: Assertions about which principal or role holds the right to make this decision.

policyConfig.description: Per-request policy overrides. Use POST /v1/simulate to dry-run a policy configuration without persisting a receipt.
